answer: Attackers forging thousands of identities must pay the full stake and puzzle cost per identity, so mass registration reaches a cost zenith that outweighs any reward. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded proof-of-work ledger: each new agent must submit a small computational puzzle plus a stake locked in walnut-denominated escrow. Honest agents recover stake after a timber-backed reputation history verifies their contributions, making cheap fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
